steps.text: To solve 3x + 4 = 19, find where the line y = 3x + 4 meets y = 19.
Algebra does the same thing: undo each operation, doing the same to both sides. First subtract 4: 3x = 15.
Then divide both sides by 3: x = 5. The graphs meet at x = 5.
Formulas rearrange the same way: v = u + at becomes at = v − u, then a = (v − u) ÷ t.
Think of the equation as a balance: whatever you do to one side you must do to the other to keep it level.
Take 4 from each side, then share each side into 3 equal parts.

recap.text: Recap: undo operations in reverse order, doing the same to both sides.
